clips.text: Why one blood test may not settle perimenopause.
During perimenopause, hormone levels go up and down.
One test is a single moment.
UK NICE guidance: for otherwise healthy women over forty-five, it can be diagnosed from symptoms and period changes.
Other tests may still be needed, to check for other causes.
So a clear record of symptoms and cycles matters.
The Perimenopause Companion helps you build one. Link in bio.
